responsibility: Implements the glibc-based operating-system hooks used only by GCC’s D frontend. It defines the TARGET_D_OS_VERSIONS hook to register Posix plus any GNU-user and extra target-specific D builtin version identifiers, and it installs TARGET_D_REGISTER_OS_TARGET_INFO handlers so D __traits(getTargetInfo, "objectFormat") reports the glibc target object format as ELF. This file is the D-language companion to glibc-c.cc and generic GNU/Linux configuration headers, focused specifically on D OS-version branding and target-info exposure rather than general specs or backend code generation.
